services.desc: We do not provide drivers. Your driver must be 21 and present a valid driver’s license and the credit card used at purchase. Why take a tour with a bunch of strangers when you could throw a pizza party on a private pontoon boat for just you and your friends? Avoid the crowds and cruise with BBQ Pontoon instead! When you rent a boat with us you’re the captain, so you can take in all of Chicago’s architectural wonders at your own pace and with whomever you want. We even give you a free pizza to cook while you sit back and relax during your Chicago pontoon rental. We also have free parking! All boats come equipped with a grill so you can serve up your favorite pies. Dinner with a view has never been tastier. Book online to reserve a BBQ Pontoon boat
